digest.component_or_area: outbound comment differ / rich text codec
propositions: Under rich_text_cutover='cloud', the outbound comment differ computes its local and Jira-side body-equality keys using different decoder compositions (local: markdown round trip with escaping; Jira: plain adf_to_text without escaping), causing in-limit markdown comments to never match their own landed bodies.

The send path encodes the DECORATED body (with HTML comment annotation), which causes markdown_to_adf to degrade the entire document to plain text encoding, while the local key derives from the UNDECORATED body through rich markdown round-trip, creating wire/key divergence.

The local key should derive by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it through the same _normalize_comment_body used for the Jira-side key, ensuring both keys use one decoder composition.
The truncation notice facet exhibits the same asymmetry: local key carries escaped `\[truncated by reconciler\]` while the landed body carries unescaped `[truncated by reconciler]`.
